script_text: Brace yourself, Scorpio — Pluto’s Aquarius shift sparks a water‑fueled power surge. On Monday, Mars in Gemini trines Pluto in the 8th house, sharpening investigative edge. Tuesday, Mercury in Pisces sextiles Pluto, boosting intuition for a money opportunity. The pivotal moment arrives Thursday as the Sun conjuncts Chiron in Aries, highlighting a self‑worth wound that, once healed, fuels ambition. Friday through Sunday, the Moon moves through your 10th house in Leo and trines Mars, boosting work confidence. The weekend’s lunar vibe also harmonizes with Venus in Pisces, favoring romance and creative projects. Wednesday is your power day: Venus enters your 5th house (Pisces) and sextiles Jupiter in Cancer, enhancing love and creativity. Saturday tests you as Saturn in Aries squares Uranus in Gemini, bringing sudden work changes that demand flexibility. Use Tuesday’s Mercury‑Pluto sextile to declutter your workspace and invite fresh chances. Follow for daily updates.
